title: Speyer's non-negativity conjecture for matroid g-polynomials
statement: Let $\mathsf{M}$ be a matroid, and let $g_{\mathsf{M}}(t)\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ denote its $g$-polynomial. **Speyer's conjecture.** For every matroid $\mathsf{M}$, the polynomial $g_{\mathsf{M}}(t)$ has non-negative coefficients. This conjecture concerns positivity of the covaluative $g$-polynomial, which is known in the source for the Schubert-matroid setting but is asserted here for arbitrary matroids; its general resolution status is not specified.
source_name: Luis Ferroni, “Schubert matroids, Delannoy paths, and Speyer's invariant”, arXiv:2311.01397 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01397

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2023).
